root_cause: The tab activation routine does not move keyboard focus to the newly selected tab when navigating with arrow keys, leaving focus on the previous element or the body.
repair_strategy: Add element.focus() in the _activate method's complete callback for elements with role='tab' to ensure focus follows selection during keyboard navigation.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft navigation will move focus to each tab in sequence, making the tab both aria-selected=true and focused, satisfying keyboard operability and focus order requirements.
functional_risks: Calling focus() on a tab could cause unexpected scrolling if the tab is not visually visible, but tabs are always visible in the tablist.
If a consumer has attached a focusin/out handler that prevents focus, the explicit focus might be overridden, but this is unlikely.
The change only affects tabs (role='tab'); other elements like dropdown items are unaffected.
verification_requirements: After the edit, pressing ArrowRight from the Account tab should set aria-selected=true on #tab-notifications and move focus to #tab-notifications.
Pressing ArrowRight again should set aria-selected=true on #tab-billing and move focus to #tab-billing.
Mouse clicks on tabs should continue to work as before.
Tab panels should still show/hide correctly when tabs are activated via keyboard or mouse.
